subject: Community Preservation Act Funding Recommendations
overview: The committee voted to recommend more than $2 million in Community Preservation Act funding for ten projects covering historic preservation, open space, and affordable housing. The committee also introduced a new member and deferred a decision on the Hegner Center project at the applicant's request.

items.title: City Council Chamber Window Restoration Presentation
items.summary: Paul Righi presented a proposal for historically accurate restoration of failing windows in the City Council chambers to prevent structural failure.

items.title: New Member Introduction
items.summary: The committee introduced new member Mayesha and existing members provided professional backgrounds.

items.title: Carr Park Renovation Phase Two
items.summary: Approved a recommendation for $146,000 in funding for the second phase of Carr Park renovations.

items.title: Condon Shell Lighting Improvements
items.summary: Approved a recommendation for $98,285 for electrical improvements at the Condon Shell, noting satisfaction with a memo regarding park operating hours.

items.title: Playstead Park Tennis Courts Reconstruction
items.summary: Approved a recommendation for $526,000 for court reconstruction with conditions requiring a maintenance plan and striping for pickleball.

items.title: Unitarian Universalist Church Siding Restoration
items.summary: Approved a $99,000 recommendation for exterior siding restoration with conditions regarding historic standards and the exclusion of religious imagery.

items.title: City Hall Council Chambers Window Restoration Approval
items.summary: Approved a $322,500 recommendation for window restoration with requirements for photographic documentation and efforts to designate City Hall as a local historic district.

items.title: Oak Grove Cemetery Building Restoration
items.summary: Approved an $85,000 recommendation for building restoration planning at Oak Grove Cemetery.

items.title: Shiloh Baptist Church ADA Improvements
items.summary: Approved a $400,000 recommendation for ADA improvements and building preservation at Shiloh Baptist Church.

items.title: Medford Affordable Housing Trust Seed Funding
items.summary: Approved a recommendation for $250,000 to initiate operations for the Affordable Housing Trust.

items.title: ABCD Medford Move-in Program
items.summary: Approved a recommendation for $100,000 for rental assistance with conditions requiring increased outreach partnership with the Medford Housing Authority.

items.title: Hegner Center Project Update
items.summary: Tabled the Hegner Center funding request as city departments seek to further refine the project scope and internal planning.

items.title: Community Outreach and Tabling Debrief
items.summary: Reviewed feedback from the Winter Extravaganza event and discussed public requests for future park improvements at Barry Park.
